aboutH2: Paradise Valley Healing Center: Residential Addiction and Trauma Care in Squamish, BC
intro: Paradise Valley Healing Center is located on 10 stunning acres close to the Cheakamus River. The rehab facility is located only one hour north of Vancouver, British Columbia. Formerly known as Chopra Addiction and Wellness Center, Paradise Valley is dedicated to addressing a broad range of addictive behaviors like depression, anxiety, and psychological trauma using a holistic approach. Paradise Valley offers 2,4, and 6 week wellness programs that provide care for the whole body, mind, and spirit.

pillars.title: Treatment Programs
pillars.body: Paradise Valley provides individual counseling and group therapy to do deep work with clients. The healing process combines the most cutting-edge Western medicine with Eastern healing arts. Ayurvedic services such as yoga, meditation, massage therapy, acupuncture, and vegetarian cuisine are available to guests. The facility accommodates a maximum of 9 residential guests, providing a high degree of personal care and attention. Additionally, the rehab center urges family members to take part in the healing and recovery process.

pillars.title: Setting and Accommodations
pillars.body: The setting of Paradise Valley is equally as important as the holistic treatment they provide. The peace and tranquility of the river and mountains in the vicinity add to the therapeutic effect. The cozy home has gender-specific accommodations and guests share a bedroom furnished with single beds. Other common areas in the house include a lounge with a fireplace and a large living room. The Center offers a true holistic program with its stunning surroundings, promoting relaxation and inner healing.

pillars.title: The Benefits of Choosing Paradise Valley
pillars.body: Paradise Valley Healing Center offers a range of benefits to people on the journey to healing and recovery. The facility’s holistic approach helps address emotional, physical, and psychological issues. Ayurvedic services, yoga, meditation, and acupuncture are some of the services that provide support in this regard. The small size of the facility allows for a more intimate and personalized care approach, while family members are involved in the process, and the nurturing environment of the surrounding nature eases the healing process.

overviewH2: Paradise Valley Healing Center: Center Overview
overview: Paradise Valley Healing Center offers a customized, individualized, and highly intensive program that is tailored to meet the specific needs of each guest. Our team of highly qualified and experienced therapists and addiction specialists provides personalized care and support to ensure that each guest receives the most effective treatment possible. Our program includes a range of evidence-based therapies, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, and other scientifically proven modalities.

location.heading: Paradise Valley Healing Center in Squamish, British Columbia
location.intro: The centre sits on 10 acres beside the Cheakamus River in Paradise Valley, just north of Squamish in the Sea to Sky corridor, about an hour's drive from Vancouver on Highway 99. Whistler is around 45 minutes further north, Horseshoe Bay and North Vancouver about 45 minutes south, and people coming from Nanaimo should allow about 3 hours including the ferry to Horseshoe Bay.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Paradise Valley Healing Center cost?
faqs.a: The centre does not publish its fees online, and its FAQ asks you to call 1-888-802-3001 for current rates. Recovery.com lists an estimate of $15,000 and up for a stay of 14 days or more. Your total depends on how many residential weeks you need, and the centre says an average stay is 4 to 12 weeks.

faqs.q: What is the recommended duration of stay at Paradise Valley Healing Center?
faqs.a: Paradise Valley Healing Center offers 2,4, and 6 week wellness programs.

faqs.q: Does Paradise Valley Healing Center offer detox?
faqs.a: No, it is not a detox facility. A Squamish Chief profile of the centre says people should not need detox at the time they are admitted, and the centre's own website does not describe withdrawal management. If you take prescribed medication, it has to arrive blister packed with enough supply for your whole stay, so sort that out with admissions before you book.

faqs.q: Where is Paradise Valley Healing Center and how do I get there?
faqs.a: It is at 3501 Paradise Valley Road in Squamish, BC, about an hour north of Vancouver on the Sea to Sky Highway. There is no parking for residents, so plan to be dropped off. If you come by bus, a staff member will collect you at the depot on intake day, and admissions can arrange transport from Vancouver International Airport.

faqs.q: Is this a private, paid centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, Paradise Valley is a private, fee-for-service centre and it does not bill insurers directly. You pay the fees yourself and then send a claim to your extended health or private insurer, so check what your plan covers before you go. Canadian residents should bring their provincial health card, and visitors from outside Canada need travel health insurance.

Guests who finish a 28-day program can use the centre's aftercare incentive, which partly funds up to 12 weeks of weekly therapy with a counsellor in their own community, starting within seven days of discharge. Staff follow up every three months for the first year and once a year after that. The residential programs also include weekly alumni Zoom groups and calls from the guest care team.

faqs.q: What are the available services at Paradise Valley Healing Center?
faqs.a: Paradise Valley Healing Center offers Ayurvedic services such as yoga, meditation, massage therapy, acupuncture, and vegetarian cuisine to support the healing process.

faqs.q: What kind of therapy sessions are offered at Paradise Valley Healing Center?
faqs.a: Paradise Valley Healing Center provides individual counseling and group therapy to help clients with deep work.

faqs.q: What is the maximum number of guests at Paradise Valley Healing Center?
faqs.a: Paradise Valley Healing Center accommodates a maximum of 9 residential guests.

faqs.q: What size are the guest rooms at Paradise Valley Healing Center?
faqs.a: Guests at Paradise Valley Healing Center share a bedroom with single beds, usually with one or two other guests.

faqs.q: How are family members involved in the healing process at Paradise Valley Healing Center?
faqs.a: Paradise Valley Healing Center urges family members to take part in the healing and recovery process.

faqs.q: Can family visit me during my stay?
faqs.a: Yes, on weekends between 2 pm and 4 pm on Saturday and Sunday. You talk through who will visit with your counsellor in the first week, and the clinical team can decline a visit it thinks would set you back. The family weekend program is included in your fees, though relatives pay for their own travel and accommodation.
